breakdown.title: Riding into the Pink Jellyfish
breakdown.logline: A dreamer rides a bicycle off a rooftop with a blue-haired girl in a yellow raincoat, soaring through an anime city toward a giant glowing pink jellyfish, and drifts inside its light.

colours.value: super sharp, anime-like, way too orange city, pink glowing jellyfish

light.value: warm late evening light, city lights starting to come on, pink glow inside jellyfish

texture.value: blocks of colour, translucent jellyfish, soft at edges inside

breakdown.world_logic: A bicycle can fly off a roof and ride through the air into a giant jellyfish; everything is accepted without question.

style_options.name: anime cel shading
style_options.dream: sharp outlines hold shapes that can't exist, so the impossible feels as solid as the ordinary
style_options.line: bold, confident lines that make the unreal feel like a world with its own rules.
tokens: cel shading with crisp black outlines
style_options.lighting_rules: The light is flat and uniform, casting no shadows. Every surface is evenly lit, emphasizing the poster-like quality of the colors. Edges are clean and defined, creating a crisp layered world.

style_options.name: soft pastel drawing
style_options.dream: colors blend at the edges like the memory of light, as if the scene is still forming
style_options.line: gentle, hazy strokes that make the world feel like a half-remembered dream.
style_options.lighting_rules: Light is diffused and soft, with gentle blending between tones. Shadows are light and faint, with no hard edges. The overall impression is luminous, as if the paper itself glows.

style_options.name: vivid watercolour
style_options.dream: the paint blooms beyond its outlines as though the dream might dissolve back into water at any second
style_options.line: vivid washes that bleed into one another, keeping the dream flowing.
style_options.lighting_rules: Light glows through translucent washes, creating a luminous effect. Colors bleed softly into one another, with edges dissolving. There are no harsh shadows; shades are built from layered transparent color.

style_options.name: photograph
style_options.dream: the light is exactly as it was, but the world holds still in a way no waking moment does
style_options.line: crisp and immediate, like a snapshot of a place you will never stand in again.
style_options.lighting_rules: The light is late evening sun, casting long warm shadows but still bright enough to keep colors vivid. Edges are sharp, capturing the crisp detail of the moment.

m1.text: The shot is seen from behind them, about 4 metres off, at the height of their eyes, with a 24mm lens looking straight toward the roof edge. In the middle distance, the dreamer stands left of center, back to camera, seen whole from a third to two-thirds down; the girl stands right of center, back to camera, seen whole from a third to two-thirds down. The old red bicycle is in the left third of the picture, from the middle down to two-thirds down. The background is the roof edge, and beyond it the anime city of blocks of colour fills the lower part of the frame. The light comes from the city beyond, soft and even on their backs. The rooftop continues just outside the left and right edges, and the sky is just above the top edge.
m1.view: Seen from behind them, about 4 metres off, at the height of their eyes: the camera looks toward the edge overlooking the city. A 24mm lens. From left to right across the picture: the dreamer, left of the middle of the picture, their back to the camera, seen whole and filling the picture from a third of the way down to two thirds of the way down; then the girl, right of the middle of the picture, their back to the camera, seen whole and filling the picture from a third of the way down to two thirds of the way down. Nobody else is in the picture. They keep these places in every picture of this scene. The old red bicycle, the left third of the picture, filling the picture from its middle to two thirds of the way down. At the back of the picture: the edge overlooking the city.

m6.text: The shot is a first-person view through the window of an old red bicycle, using a wide 24mm lens, with the camera at the height of a seated person's eyes looking straight ahead. In the foreground, the girl sits beside the camera, her back to it, seen from the knees up, centered and filling the frame from about one third down to near the bottom. In the middle distance, the front of the bicycle is visible ahead, and beyond it the direction of travel into the jellyfish extends across the picture from the left edge to the right edge. In the background, a pink glow fills the area directly ahead. Pink light from the glow illuminates the girl and the bicycle interior. The edges of the bicycle window frame the view.
m6.view: The camera is the dreamer's eyes, in the old red bicycle, at the height of their eyes sitting, looking straight ahead: it looks toward the direction of travel into the jellyfish. A wide lens, about 24mm. The inside of the old red bicycle frames the picture: its front ahead and the edges of its window around the view. Nearest, a little way off, in the middle of the picture: the girl, sitting beside the dreamer on the same old red bicycle, their back to the camera, seen from the knees up and filling the picture from a third of the way down to near its bottom. Across the picture from the left edge to the right edge: the direction of travel into the jellyfish, the front of the place. Beyond it all, ahead where they look: the pink glow just ahead as we enter.

m5.text: The shot is from the dreamer's point of view, with a 24mm wide lens at eye level sitting, looking straight ahead. The frame is filled by the inside of the old red bicycle: its front section is visible ahead and the edges of its window frame the view. In the middle of the picture, a little way off, the girl sits beside the dreamer on the same bicycle, her back to the camera, seen from the knees up, filling the picture from a third of the way down to near the bottom. In the background, the city lights are starting to come on below, and above them ahead floats the huge translucent pink jellyfish, its tentacles hanging down between the buildings. The light comes from the city lights and the pink glow of the jellyfish, illuminating the girl's shoulders and the bicycle frame. Just outside the frame are the bicycle's handlebars and the dreamer's hands on them.

m7.text: First-person view from the dreamer's eyes, wide 24mm lens, camera at sitting eye height leaning a little right and turned right toward the girl. The old red bicycle's interior window frame runs around the picture, its front ahead, soft in the foreground. In the middle distance, the girl fills the picture from the left third to the right edge, seen from shoulders up in profile facing left, wearing a yellow raincoat, sharp and dominant. Behind her, the background is the glowing pink interior of the jellyfish, and far below through the window edge the city is tiny. The light comes from the pink bioluminescence of the jellyfish surrounding them, falling on her yellow raincoat. Just outside the picture on the left is the direction of travel deeper into the jellyfish.

Nearest, close, across the picture from the left third to the right edge: the girl, beside the dreamer in the same old red bicycle, in profile, looking toward the left of the picture, seen from the shoulders up and filling the picture from its top edge to its bottom edge. m4.text: The shot is seen from behind, 4 metres back, at the seated riders' eye level, with a 24mm lens, angled slightly upward toward the pink jellyfish ahead. In the foreground, across the lower half of the picture, the old red bicycle appears centered, its frame and wheels partially visible from the middle down to near the bottom, partly hidden by the dreamer's body. In the middle distance, the dreamer sits on the bicycle left of center, back to camera, whole body visible from one-third down to two-thirds down, partly hidden by the bicycle; the girl sits at the center, back to camera, whole body visible from one-third down to the middle, also partly hidden by the bicycle. In the background, the huge pink jellyfish floats high above the city ahead, centered along the direction of travel, with the open sky around it. The light comes from the sun on the left, softly lighting the riders' backs and the pink jellyfish; just outside the picture below is the city far beneath the flying bicycle.
